rationale: The workflow already incorporates the evidence-supported optimizations that apply to it: dependency caching via setup-node cache:pnpm (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), path-filtered push triggers (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER), concurrency cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), and a step timeout on the deploy step (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). The remaining patterns do not apply: there is no Bazel build (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no schedule (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), and no tests to prioritize or select (P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-SELECT). As a deployment workflow, cancellation/skipping patterns carry contraindications, and there is only one observed run in history, which is not representative enough to derive a job-level timeout (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT). No evidence-supported, applicable change is missing; adding unsupported changes would risk the deploy contract without demonstrated benefit.
